subject: PrivDeploy operator certification, temporary witness access & KMS custody options
messages:

Subject: PrivDeploy audit window + operator certification request

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for last week's demo. We are preparing for a regulatory readiness audit (Q3) and need to confirm the operational evidence path for a Private (VPC) deployment. Can Redwood provide:  

- A statement of operator responsibilities and a brief on what an "operator witness" can/ cannot do during an audit (temporary console access vs witness-only flows).
- Options for KMS custody (customer-managed key split custody, Redwood-held with attestation, or escrow-like key escrow third party).
- A short list of artifacts we can expect to receive ahead of the audit (snapshots, logs, runbook, signed witness checklist).
- Whether you can support a short on-site or remote witnessing window (we prefer remote, but will consider on-site in CA).

We also need a narrow MSA/Order Form addendum that: limits operator access during witness windows, documents license boundaries for on-prem components, and describes delivery of forensic artifacts. Procurement copied me for timeline/PO.  

Attached: Helio_Audit_Request_20270629.pdf (audit scope + tentative dates). Can we get a suggested approach and a timeline by next Friday?

Regards,
Sarah Lang
Director, Regulatory Operations
HelioHealth

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear scope. Looping in Irene (legal) and David (private deployments) to confirm the options and produce a short addendum + operational plan. High-level response below so procurement has an initial timeline: 

- We can produce an addendum that narrows operator privileges during a witness window and enumerates artifacts delivered.
- KMS custody: we can support customer-managed KMS (preferred), a split-custody model, or a limited-scope escrow with a vetted third party — each has tradeoffs (I'll defer to Irene/David for the details).
- For evidence delivery we typically provide time-stamped snapshots, signed runbook checklist, and filtered logs; full forensic exports require an on-site or approved secure-transfer process.
- Remote witnessing is usually done via staged snapshot + shared view session; we avoid granting persistent console access.

I'll aim to get a redline addendum and an ops checklist back by Friday (2027-07-02). David/Irene — can you confirm operational constraints and legal must-haves?

Best,
Markus
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

From: irene_choi@redwood.ai
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, Sarah Lang <regops@heliohealth.com>
Cc: david_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PrivDeploy audit window + operator certification request

Sarah/Markus — thanks, quick legal-first take and proposed redlines to scope the addendum. I'm attaching a working doc (redline-privdeploy-addendum-v1.docx) with edits, the highlights are below: 

1) License/Scope: The addendum should explicitly state that customer license covers: model runtime, inference artifacts, and customer-provisioned data only — Redwood's pre-trained model weights and internal tooling remain licensed. This avoids unintended derivative-rights language.

2) Operator access: We will not provide interactive write-capable console access. Options we can accept:
   - Witness-only session: ephemeral read-only session brokered by Redwood with recorded screen share and signed witness checklist.
   - Limited API/ snapshot extraction: Redwood produces cryptographically signed snapshot delivered to customer in a secured envelope.

3) KMS/custody: 
   - Preferred: Customer-managed KMS integration (customer supplies CMK; Redwood uses KMS APIs but never has key material).
   - Alternative: Split-custody: customer + Redwood each hold partial material/ tokens — requires SOW and ops checklist.
   - Last resort: Third-party escrow for key release requires explicit trigger events and on-site verification; highly limited and subject to procurement.

4) Evidence/Forensics: We can define a bounded artifact set: timestamped snapshots, operator action logs (redacted), and an audit manifest. Requests for raw disk images or full forensic exports will require case-by-case legal approval and may incur professional-services fees.

5) Insurance/PO gating: Procurement should confirm insurance clauses and PO timelines; if Helio requires on-site attendance we will surface travel and PS estimates.

Irene
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: redline-privdeploy-addendum-v1.docx (initial legal redlines)

From: david_kim@redwood.ai
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai, Sarah Lang <regops@heliohealth.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PrivDeploy audit window + operator certification request

Folks — operational notes and constraints from the deployment team: 

- We cannot grant direct, interactive console write access to external auditors. Exceptions only under on-site supervised witness with an approved access window and legal sign-off.

- For remote audits we offer two practical options: 
   A) Snapshot + live review: We create a time-stamped snapshot, transfer to a secure staging bucket, and conduct a live remote walkthrough (screen share + recorded QA). Snapshot transfer uses customer CMK when available.
   B) Witnessed runbook execution: Redwood runs pre-approved verification steps in our environment while auditors observe. We record the session and provide a signed checklist.

- KMS integration: we can integrate into customer KMS (recommended) or set up split-key workflow. Split-key requires an operations SOW to document key generation, split, and storage lifecycle — estimate 3 weeks of ops engineering.

- Artifacts we can deliver within standard SLOs: config manifest, runtime logs (filtered), snapshot manifest + md5/sha256 signatures, and a signed witness checklist. Full forensic exports will require an extended engagement.

Proposed near-term timeline (assuming we receive signed addendum and PO):
  - Week 1: Finalize addendum and schedule witness window.
  - Week 2: Prepare snapshot and runbook; validation test with Helio ops.
  - Week 3: Witness session and artifact delivery.

If Helio elects on-site witnessing, travel and secure-hardware handling add 1-2 weeks.

-David
Director, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: operational-runbook-template.txt (runbook stub)
